prompt: How many countries were not listed as offering only paid access to YouTube Music at the time of its initial expansion in 2018?
answer: **16 countries.** The June 2018 expansion covered 17 countries, but South Korea was explicitly noted as offering only the paid YouTube Premium tier; the remaining 16 were not listed as paid-only.
